description: Minimum wage for one US state or DC on a date in 2026-2027: standard hourly rate, tipped cash wage, tip credit and the date the rate took effect. Uses the US DOL July 2026 tables and state labor department pages checked October 2026, including increases on July 1, September 30 and January 1, 2027 that postdate most model training data. Applies the $7.25 federal floor when a state has no law or a lower rate, and says so. Inflation-indexed 2027 rates not yet published are reported as not announced, never estimated. State-level only: city and county rates are not included.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD between 2026-01-01 and 2027-12-31. Defaults to today.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, or DC. Examples: "California", "TX", "District of Columbia".

name: get_minimum_wage
title: Get state minimum wage
